text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: unusual POSTs to /internal/session-sample (honeypot) from ~120 distinct IPs over last 7m. Spike in 401/403 and several requests containing Authorization header with pattern 'svc-token:' in debug logs. Tagging on-call. https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC12345

jamal: oncall-amy can you take? this looks like possible token harvesting hitting our honeypot path.

oncall-amy: taking. thanks. initial triage: spike started ~07:12 UTC. are we seeing any successful session creations or writes?

sec-ian: copying initial findings from log run: saw many attempts with header 'Authorization: svc-token abcd...'. All appear malformed; no valid session create response codes (200). A few 204/302 for probes. Might be credential stuffing or scanner.

sre-luca: can you dump the raw request samples to a staging bucket? I'll isolate the target ASG and throttle ingress to that path.

marta: I already seeded a bucket: s3://sec-samples/session-honeypot/2723456789/ with the first 50 request bodies and headers. (reacts :eyes:)

eng-ryan: quick check — any customer-facing proxies returning 2xx for these tokens? if not, customer impact may be none.

customer-kate: I'll stand by to notify impacted customers if tokens were valid. please confirm before I draft anything.

oncall-amy: SRE, start containment: add WAF rule to block the pattern and block top 25 IPs for now. Also flip request sampling to 100% on that route for additional captures.

sre-luca: running containment commands now:
```bash
# block top offending ips (example)
for ip in 3.12.45.6 13.52.9.8 45.33.22.11; do aws wafv2 update-ip-set --name "honeypot-block" --addresses "$ip/32"; done
# isolate ASG
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name service-proxy-honeypot --min-size 0 --max-size 0
```

sec-ian: good. also start a service token validity audit: list recent token validations for the last 24h and look for any matches to the token prefixes in the samples. prioritize tokens issued to internal svc accts.

jamal: I already grep'd auth logs — only 12 validation attempts reached the auth layer and all failed. No token exchange to downstream services.

oncall-amy: that's promising. SRE, keep the blocks in place and leave sampling. Sec, rotate the proxy service token that could be in logs just in case. Add a one-off service token rotation job and coordinate downtime with eng.

eng-ryan: will do. plan: create new proxy service token, update config in the proxy pool, restart 3 small nodes. No customer-facing downtime expected due to pool fallback.

sec-ian: notify infra teams to rotate any keys that might have been logged to debug for the last 48h. We should also run a quick grep across s3 access logs for 'svc-token' string.

marta: s3 grep results: found debug snapshots from one staging instance that included a truncated header. No customer IDs present. Saving matched object keys to s3://sec-samples/session-honeypot/2723456789/matches.txt

customer-kate: thanks — based on that, go/no-go for customer notification?

oncall-amy: based on current evidence: NO verified leaked customer tokens and no successful sessions. We will not notify customers yet. If sec finds any valid token or a downstream auth success we escalate.

sec-ian: rotation started for: proxy-service-token-v3. Timeline: start 07:40 UTC, target complete 07:46 UTC. I'll file rotation IDs in the incident ticket.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of proxy config underway — 3/3 updated, health checks green.

sre-luca: WAF rule deployed and top offending IPs blackholed. Sampling increased to 100% and retention of captures set to 30 days.

jamal: also adding temporary rate-limit per IP on the gateway for that route to 10r/m.

sec-ian: running defensive scans for credential leakage across recent public log dumps and pastebins. nothing matched our internal token format so far.

marta: uploaded all artifacts and a short playbook to the ticket: https://ticketing/INC12345/artifacts. includes list of blocked IPs, s3 keys, and grep outputs.

customer-kate: standing by to push comms if you flip to notify. draft ready.

oncall-amy: action items summary:
- SRE: keep blocks + isolation + sampling (sre-luca)
- Eng: rotate proxy token and update pool (eng-ryan)
- Sec: run token validity audit & external search (sec-ian)
- CS: hold comms, prep draft (customer-kate)
- Ops: retain artifacts and monitor (marta, jamal)

sec-ian: audit results: token validity scan completed — no matches to live tokens, only malformed strings. external search: nothing real. No signs of exfil.

oncall-amy: lowering alert level to monitoring. leave WAF blocks for 24h then reassess.

ops-bot: Incident INC12345 status changed to 'mitigated' by oncall-amy. Monitoring mode enabled.

marta: thanks team. I'll archive samples and mark the ticket for a follow-up runbook update to ensure debug logs never include raw auth headers.

eng-ryan: I'll push the runbook change: remove debug-level header dumps and add redaction at the ingress layer.

customer-kate: closing loop with CS: no customer notification required at this time.

oncall-amy: great job. if anything new appears we'll reopen. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
